annotations.grafana.app/message: MinIO Metrics V3 tabs and section variables

spec.description: MinIO server metrics using Metrics V3 and Grafana tab layouts

spec.title: Process Saturation
spec.description: File-descriptor utilization, goroutines, and active namespace locks on this peer.

spec.title: Cluster Usage / Scanner Age
spec.description: Cluster-wide usage metadata age and leader-reported scanner activity; these values are shared by every MinIO instance.

spec.title: Cluster Objects / Versions / Buckets
spec.description: Cluster-wide usage counters deduplicated across the MinIO servers that report them.
Cluster-wide bucket count reported by the selected instance's MinIO cluster.
Cluster-wide object count reported by the selected instance's MinIO cluster.

spec.title: MinIO Instance
spec.description: MinIO server identity, pool membership, uptime, disk count and normalized local capacity.

spec.expr: sum by (ins) (minio_system_drive_free_bytes{job="minio", ins="$ins"}) or (sum by (ins) (minio_system_drive_total_bytes{job="minio", ins="$ins"}) * 0)

sum by (ins) (minio_system_drive_total_bytes{job="minio", ins="$ins"})
- (sum by (ins) (minio_system_drive_free_bytes{job="minio", ins="$ins"}) or (sum by (ins) (minio_system_drive_total_bytes{job="minio", ins="$ins"}) * 0))

1 - 
(sum by (ins) (minio_system_drive_free_bytes{job="minio", ins="$ins"}) or (sum by (ins) (minio_system_drive_total_bytes{job="minio", ins="$ins"}) * 0)) /
sum by (ins) (minio_system_drive_total_bytes{job="minio", ins="$ins"})
job:syslog ip:$ip (app:minio OR unit:minio OR app:silo OR unit:silo) (* $search) | stats count() as count
job:syslog ip:$ip (app:minio OR unit:minio OR app:silo OR unit:silo) (* $search)

spec.title: Inflight / Incoming Requests
spec.description: Current S3 requests executing or waiting. Explicit zero baselines avoid false No Data when the node is idle.

spec.title: Internode Bandwidth
spec.description: Traffic between this MinIO peer and the other cluster members.

spec.title: API TTFB p95 / p99
spec.description: Five-minute S3 time-to-first-byte distribution. No data means this instance served no matching requests in the window.

spec.title: Cluster Scanner Throughput
spec.description: Cluster scanner rates reported by the active scanner leader; they are not per-instance counters.

spec.title: Cluster Bucket Scan Cycles
spec.description: Cluster bucket scan cycles reported by the active scanner leader over the last hour.

spec.title: Cluster Scanner / Usage Freshness
spec.description: Cluster-wide freshness gauges; scanner activity is emitted by the active scanner leader.

spec.title: Cluster ILM Scan Rate
spec.description: Cluster lifecycle scanner rate reported by the active scanner leader.

spec.title: Disk Inventory
spec.description: Host block-device details limited to devices backing this instance's /data* MinIO mounts.

spec.expr: (max by (device) (irate(node_disk_read_time_seconds_total{ip="$ip"}[1m]) / irate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{ip="$ip"}[1m])) or (max by (device) (irate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{ip="$ip"}[1m])) * 0)) and on (device) (max by (device) (label_replace(node_filesystem_size_bytes{ip="$ip",mountpoint=~"/data.*"}, "device", "$1", "device", "/dev/(.*)")))

(max by (device) (irate(node_disk_write_time_seconds_total{ip="$ip"}[1m]) / irate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{ip="$ip"}[1m])) or (max by (device) (irate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{ip="$ip"}[1m])) * 0)) and on (device) (max by (device) (label_replace(node_filesystem_size_bytes{ip="$ip",mountpoint=~"/data.*"}, "device", "$1", "device", "/dev/(.*)")))

spec.title: Disk $drive
spec.description: MinIO drive state for the selected mount; host block metrics below use the resolved $device.

spec.title: Selected Disk IOPS / Bandwidth
spec.description: Selected host block-device IOPS on the left axis and bandwidth on the right axis, matched from the MinIO instance by IP.

spec.title: Resource Saturation
spec.description: Normalized CPU, memory, capacity and disk pressure.

spec.title: Alert Events
spec.description: Firing and pending MinIO alerts in the selected scope.

spec.title: Cluster Logical Data Size
spec.description: Cluster-wide logical object bytes; per-bucket series are intentionally not collected.

spec.title: Cluster Object Size Distribution
spec.description: Cluster-wide object-size distribution deduplicated across reporting servers.

spec.title: Cluster Version Count Distribution
spec.description: Cluster-wide object-version distribution deduplicated across reporting servers.

spec.title: Cluster Scanner Throughput
spec.description: Cluster scanner rates reported by the active scanner leader; they are not per-instance counters.

spec.title: Cluster Bucket Scan Cycles
spec.description: Cluster bucket scan cycles reported by the active scanner leader over the last hour.

spec.title: Cluster Usage / Scanner Freshness
spec.description: Cluster-wide usage and leader-reported scanner freshness shared by every MinIO instance.

spec.title: Log Volume by Level
spec.description: JSON log events grouped by severity after applying the Search expression.

spec.expr: job:syslog ip:$ip (app:minio OR unit:minio OR app:silo OR unit:silo) (* $search) | unpack_json | stats by (level) count() as count

spec.name: drive
spec.label: Disk
spec.description: Local MinIO disk selected within this tab

spec.name: device
spec.label: Device
spec.description: Host block device resolved by MinIO IP from the selected drive mount, with /data as the standard single-disk fallback.

spec.name: search
spec.label: Search
spec.description: VictoriaLogs query terms appended to the MinIO log selector

spec.title: MinIO Instance

spec.name: ins
spec.label: Instance
spec.description: Minio Instance Name

spec.name: cls
spec.label: Cluster
spec.description: Minio Cluster Name

spec.name: ip
spec.label: IP
spec.description: Minio IP Address
